notes.title: Creatures of Ava OST
notes.content:
[h1]🎵 Creatures of Ava Original Soundtrack  🎵[/h1]
[h2] by Adrian Berenguer [/h2]

Greetings, Creature Savers!

We're very happy to announce that the enchanting melodies of Ava, composed by the talented Adrian Berenguer, have found their way beyond the game and into your favorite music platforms. The Creatures of Ava Original Game Soundtrack is now available for streaming!

[url=https://orcd.co/creaturesofava][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913460/59786471ab9bc43dae20b91a16b35af01404620f.png[/img][/url]

[h2]🎧 About the Composer[/h2]
Adrian Berenguer (ANBR), born in Barcelona, brings a wealth of musical expertise to Creatures of Ava. With a musical journey beginning at age 10, Berenguer has:
[list]
[*] Performed at festivals across Spain
[*] Won awards from the International Festival of Environmental Films of Chefchaouen and Playstation® Talents Music
[*] Composed for prestigious brands, films, and video games
[/list]

His unique blend of instrumental mastery and emotive composition breathes life into the world of Ava.

[h2]🌟 Where to Listen[/h2]
Immerse yourself in Berenguer's soothing yet energetic tunes that bring the vibrant world of Ava to life. From serene forest ambiances to upbeat exploration themes, this soundtrack captures the essence of your adventures.

Stream or download now:
[url=https://orcd.co/creaturesofava]Creatures of Ava OST[/url]

[previewyoutube=FMFb5eY3Wc4;full][/previewyoutube]

Whether you're revisiting fond memories of the game or seeking the perfect background music for your daily activities, this soundtrack is sure to transport you to a world of wonder and imagination.

Thank you for your continued support, and enjoy the magical sounds of Ava! 💚 🎶

Your friends at 11 bit studios

notes.title: Creatures of Ava | Free Collectibles Update
notes.content:
[h2] -- SPOILERS: This update reveals collectible locations! --[/h2]

Hey Creatures Savers!

We're excited to announce our latest addition to the Explorer Update - the Free Collectibles Update! This new feature is designed to help you uncover every secret Ava has to offer, but remember, it's entirely optional for those who prefer to discover everything on their own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913460/a3ac4e462b4975f9ad9ab62c51a5af68bba2749f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Introducing the Scout Bot[/h3]

Building on the Explorer Update, we're introducing a new companion to join Vic and Tabitha on their mission - the Scout Bot! This helpful little robot is here to assist those of you who want to ensure you don't miss out on any of Ava's hidden treasures.

[h3]How It Works[/h3]

[list]
[*] Scout Bot Locations: You'll find Scout Bots at the end of each biome.
[*] Reveal Collectibles: Interact with a Scout Bot to reveal all missing collectible locations on your map for that biome.
[*] Detailed Map: Zoom in on your map to see the precise locations of undiscovered items.
[/list]
[h3]Reminder: Creature Respawns[/h3]

Don't forget, with the Explorer Update, creatures will respawn in areas you've already cleared. This ensures you can always complete puzzles and collect any items you might have missed on your first pass.
We hope these new features enhance your exploration of Ava and help you uncover all the wonders our world has to offer. Whether you choose to use the Scout Bot or prefer to search every nook and cranny yourself, the choice is yours!
Happy exploring, and thank you for your continued support! 💚

notes.title: Free Explorer Update is out now along with the 11 Facts Trailer 💚
Creatures of Ava Hotfix 1.0.1 out now!
notes.content:
Hello creature savers,

Today, we're releasing a small but much-needed hotfix to address some important issues a few of you have encountered.

[b]Improvements:[/b][list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Tabitha's teleport that caused some players to have no active main quest. (If you were affected by this bug, the main quest should automatically fix itself when you load the game).
[*] Increased the number of autosaves from 10 to 20.
[*] Blinder plant decals now display correctly.
[*] Reduced blinder plant blind time from 15 to 8 seconds.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

We want to thank you all once again for your feedback, reviews, and support 💚

If you want to learn more about the upcoming changes regarding Creature Respawns and Missing Collectibles, please read our newly released "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2304440/discussions/0/4431065223196101455/]Upcoming Updates[/url]" post.

Take care,
Inverge Studios and 11 bit studios

notes.title: Thank you so much! 💚
notes.content:
[h1]Thank You![/h1]

We are thrilled to see Creatures of Ava receiving so many positive reviews. It warms our hearts to see all you creature savers enjoying your journey to Planet Ava! 
Inverge Studios is a small team of 12 dedicated developers based in Spain (let's not forget their loyal companion - dog Leo!) and together we embarked on this journey not that different from the adventures of Vic and Tabitha. They truly embody the spirit of teamwork and show their commitment to making a positive impact on the world. It's an incredible feeling to finally see all of this hard work come to light and see people play the game.


[h3]We appreciate all the positive feedback[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913460/37400bf68554b0b5de523896cdd9bbfa94a3c8ce.jpg[/img] 

[b]Creatures of Ava received a 78 score both on Metacritic and OpenCritic[/b] - thank you! 💚 Reading all the reviews was definitely exciting, and so was reading your feedback and your thoughts about our game (and all the cute creatures you can, and should, pet!).  

[h3]Please review the game! [/h3]

If you enjoyed playing Creatures of Ava, we would appreciate if you could review the game - It helps more than you can imagine. Thank you in advance! 💚

To leave a review, check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2304440/Creatures_of_Ava/ ]Creatures of Ava Steam page[/url]!
